headline: Binance to Close Certain European Accounts by Year-End Amid New Fees
summary: Binance has notified users in Spain, France, and Poland that affected accounts will close by December 31, prompting calls to withdraw crypto before fees apply.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, making regulatory and operational shifts in major European jurisdictions critical for market participants.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance faces direct operational changes and account closures in specific European countries.
